snippet.title: Geek Gurl Diaries
snippet.description:
Like Raspberry Pi, Arduino, Python, Programming, Computer Science, Logic, Electronics, and being geeky and awesome? I do, so I started to make videos for people like me!  Welcome to the Geek Gurl Diaries, where us gurl's discuss, create, demo and interview all things geek. If you have ideas for videos or tutorials, or you know someone cool I could interview then please get in touch.

I also host Crash Course Computer Science if you are interested in learning more about how computers work. https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL8dPuuaLjXtNlUrzyH5r6jN9ulIgZBpdo
